catalysts.title: Orforglipron Oral GLP-1 Approval & Global Commercial Launch
catalysts.probabilityAnchor: U.S. NDA submitted for T2D in mid-2026, over 36,000 U.S. physicians prescribers activated, and Phase 3 obesity readout package completed
catalysts.description: Orforglipron represents the first non-peptide daily oral GLP-1 receptor agonist without food or water restrictions. It bypasses cold-chain logistics and injectable syringe supply bottlenecks, opening massive global primary care markets.

evidence.fact: Management confirmed U.S. regulatory submission for orforglipron in type 2 diabetes with global commercial rollout targeted for 2027.

source.title: Eli Lilly Q2 2026 Earnings Call Prepared Remarks

evidence.fact: Prescriber footprint grew to ~36,000 clinicians following Medicare GLP-1 Bridge launch.

catalysts.title: Retatrutide (GIP/GLP-1/Glucagon Triple Agonist) BLA Filing
catalysts.probabilityAnchor: Phase 3 clinical trial package completed for obesity, OSA, and knee osteoarthritis pain; FDA BLA submission scheduled for Q1 2027
catalysts.description: Retatrutide delivers up to 24.2% mean body weight loss alongside profound improvements in metabolic biomarkers and liver fat resolution, establishing a new therapeutic benchmark superior to dual incretins.

evidence.fact: Three Phase 3 trials read out positive in Q2 2026, satisfying registration criteria across obesity, obstructive sleep apnea, and osteoarthritis.

catalysts.title: Greenfield Manufacturing Expansions (Lebanon, NC, Alzey) Coming Online
catalysts.probabilityAnchor: Over $18B committed capital expenditure in parenteral manufacturing, with Lebanon site achieving initial engineering validation runs
catalysts.description: Unprecedented multi-billion capital deployment in automated autoinjector assembly, peptide synthesis, and vial filling creates unmatched production scale that permanently resolves supply shortages.

evidence.fact: Q2 2026 volume surged 60% YoY as earlier manufacturing investments began commercial supply ramp.

catalysts.title: FDA 503B Bulks Exclusion & Compounding Channel Conversion
catalysts.probabilityAnchor: FDA proposed permanent exclusion of tirzepatide from 503B Bulks List on April 30, 2026 following official resolution of national drug shortage
catalysts.description: As regulatory loopholes allowing compounding pharmacies to formulate unapproved generic copies of tirzepatide close, an estimated 1.5M+ patients are redirected into branded Zepbound and Mounjaro channels.

evidence.fact: FDA ruled that with commercial supply normalized, no clinical justification exists for compounded bulk tirzepatide under Section 503B.

source.title: FDA Drug Shortage & Compounding Policy Announcement

catalysts.title: Escalating Commercial Payer Rebates & Statutory Medicaid Discounts
catalysts.probabilityAnchor: Realized net prices declined 13% YoY in Q2 2026 despite 60% unit volume growth, driven by channel mix shift and formulary rebate concessions
catalysts.description: Health plans and pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) require aggressive double-digit net price rebates to grant preferred tier formulary status, steadily lowering realized revenue per patient treated.

evidence.fact: Q2 2026 realized price headwind of -13% partially offset strong volume gains.

catalysts.title: Competitive Incretin Crowding (CagriSema, MariTide, Viking)
catalysts.probabilityAnchor: Novo Nordisk advancing CagriSema Phase 3 readouts and Amgen progressing monthly/quarterly dosing regimens with MariTide
catalysts.description: Next-generation competitors offering alternative dosing frequencies (monthly vs weekly) or novel dual/triple mechanisms could fragment market share and trigger aggressive price competition.

evidence.fact: Multiple Phase 3 obesity candidates from rival pharmas are scheduled for primary completion in 2026-2027.

catalysts.title: Aseptic Fill-Finish & Auto-Injector Component Dependencies
catalysts.probabilityAnchor: Parenteral device delivery systems rely on specialized high-speed sterile component suppliers with extended lead times
catalysts.description: Any interruption in sterile glass syringe barrels, stoppers, or spring-loaded injection pen mechanisms can halt production lines, constraining supply regardless of active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) inventory.

evidence.fact: Lilly Form 10-Q Item 1A highlights operational risks tied to single-source parenteral component suppliers.

catalysts.title: Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) Price Negotiation & Legislative Budget Caps
catalysts.probabilityAnchor: Senate health committee hearings on GLP-1 healthcare expenditures and looming potential eligibility for mandatory government price setting
catalysts.description: Massive state and federal budgetary exposure to obesity medication costs creates bipartisan political momentum to mandate price caps, accelerated IRA negotiation eligibility, or statutory rebate minimums.

evidence.fact: Congressional Budget Office (CBO) reports highlighted multi-hundred-billion Medicare budget impacts if anti-obesity medications are broadly covered without price statutory limits.

source.title: Congressional Budget Office Health Care Working Paper
